Name: Edging Your Rod
Author: kokinmanyou
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of trying to cast in max power?
Want to make fishing a little easier but not ruin your experience?
Just keep your rod power max for a while before it decrease!
[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]When your casting power reach the top, your power will keep in max in a short time. (default: 1s)[/color]
Or you can choice keep your power max by using stamina. (default: false , decrease 10% stamina per second)
i18n support
